Pump: A Natural History of the Heart

Bill Schutt. Algonquin, $26.95 (288p) ISBN 978-1-616-20893-6

“The history of cardiovascular medicine has no shortage of strange stories and bizarre treatments,” writes zoologist Schutt ( Cannibalism ) in this show-stopping exploration of cardiac biology. In three parts, Schutt muses on various aspects of the heart, balancing scientific facts and light anecdotes.
